title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode4 A Long Road

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness we made it here on time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On time? We're not supposed to meet for another thirty minutes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We didn't have to rush out of the house like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know...
But what if Tsukasa and Saki also got here early out of sheer excitement?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning to the both of you!
Wonderful weather for a day trip, wouldn't you say?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning. I had a feeling that you two wouldn't be far behind us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We ended up getting everything ready way before when we originally planned on leaving!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were both so excited that we decided to come here early!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's perfectly understandable. I was also so excited that I kept walking between my room and the front entrance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all sound like elementary schoolers who can't wait to go on a field trip...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm glad we're all here.
Let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start making our way towards the station.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, can we stop by the vending machines first? I forgot to buy a drink...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our train isn't scheduled to depart for a little while, so you should have plenty of time. Just be careful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... Saki went that way, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not good! She's sure to get lost!
We need to chase after her, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, everyone, let's break out...!
The potato chips♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, because they're yummy.
And I love the texture!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even have some mini-star ramen for you, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, you bought some just for me?
Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shii, you've loved these ever since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm also a longtime fan.
Particularly because it has “star” in its name! I remember a time when I had these every day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd rather not be seen as that big a fanatic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha♪ Anyway, I'll open these up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's all over the floor now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hurry, we need to clean this up!
Before we arrive at the next station!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, the next station's our stop.
Start packing, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me you lost it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've checked all my pockets, bag and everywhere else! It's completely vanished! There's no way they're going to let me out of the station!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, why didn't you just use your smart card?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The answer to that is simple! A physical ticket adds to the sentimental value of this trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me... Didn't you put it in your wallet because you were worried that you'd lose it if you put it in one of your pockets?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
The air here feels so fresh and clean.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the village has such a wonderful atmosphere to it. I'm very much looking forward to exploring it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our trip's just begun, but I'm already exhausted.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out!
They've got one of those stand-in boards! Let's take a group photo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, what a colorful cast of characters!
Alright, I'll be... This octopus at the top!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This only has room for three people, so I'll be the photographer for this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I wish we could all be in it together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, why don't we switch once you've taken ours? I'll take over on the camera next, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we don't need to take that many...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Geez, these three really just do whatever they feel... They're the complete opposite of me. I have no way of predicting what they're gonna do next...)
